sections.label: The opening
sections.line: RC2 of One Human, Nine Agents, Nineteen Hours: a 27-page draft, checked five ways, and a request for feedback.
sections.para: The book of the talk built in a day now has a title and a second release candidate, published as a draft. It is written down the zoom from 3 to 10 to 30 pages, with 70 begun, and each chapter passes five checks. Its scenes are the controls at work: reviewers catching their own team, an objection kept, a hold before the talk. It ends with five steps to build your own, and asks for feedback on LinkedIn or as an issue on the book's repository.
